description_en: Merges two face groups in a media set by calling the CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob operation
description_zh: 调用CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob接口合并媒体集中的两个人脸分组
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-merge-face-groups-job --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notification
parameters.name: notify_topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification. The document transform status can be asynchronously sent to the caller through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS), create a topic and a queue, and configure a subscription relationship. For more information, see Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) Quick Start (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，文档转换状态可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。具体操作，请参见轻量消息队列（原 MNS）快速入门 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html)。

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
parameters.name: notify_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The GroupId of the source group to be merged. The faces in this group are merged into the group specified by GroupIdTo
parameters.help_zh: 待合并的分组的GroupId，该分组中的人脸将被合并到GroupIdTo对应分组中
parameters.name: group_id_from

parameters.help_en: The GroupId of the destination group to be merged into. The faces from the group specified by GroupIdFrom are added to this group
parameters.help_zh: 待合并的分组的GroupId，该分组中将加入GroupIdFrom对应分组中的人脸
parameters.name: group_id_to

parameters.help_en: The custom message, which is returned as-is in the notification. Maximum length: 1024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义信息，在通知时回原样返回。最长1024个字符
parameters.name: custom_message

GroupIdFrom.description_en: The GroupId of the source group to be merged. The faces in this group are merged into the group specified by GroupIdTo
GroupIdFrom.description_zh: 待合并的分组的GroupId，该分组中的人脸将被合并到GroupIdTo对应分组中

GroupIdTo.description_en: The GroupId of the destination group to be merged into. The faces from the group specified by GroupIdFrom are added to this group
GroupIdTo.description_zh: 待合并的分组的GroupId，该分组中将加入GroupIdFrom对应分组中的人脸

JobId.description_en: The unique identifier of the merge face groups task
JobId.description_zh: 合并人脸分组任务的唯一标识

JobType.description_en: The task type. The value is fixed as MergeFaceGroupsJob
JobType.description_zh: 任务类型，返回值固定为MergeFaceGroupsJob

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set
